annotation.title_clean: Linee Guida sulla formazione, gestione e conservazione dei documenti informatici
annotation.title_en: Guidelines on the creation, management and preservation of electronic documents
annotation.summary_en: AgID's May 2021 guidelines setting technical rules for the creation, registration, management and long-term preservation of electronic documents by Italian public administrations under the Digital Administration Code. Unrelated to AI or robotics; it replaces earlier DPCM technical rules.
key_provisions_or_claims: Updates technical rules under Art. 71 of the Digital Administration Code (CAD).
Applies to public administrations and certain private parties under CAD Art. 2(2)-(3).
Repeals the DPCM of 13 Nov 2014 and DPCM of 3 Dec 2013 on preservation, and most of the protocol rules.
Defines document formation, protocol registration, classification, file formats, and security measures.
Sets preservation system roles, manuals, processes, and selection/disposal of documents.
